name: INNOX Advanced Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: INNOX Advanced Materials Co.,Ltd. engages in semiconductor PKG materials and flexible printed circuit board materials businesses in South Korea and internationally. The company offers circuit materials for smartphones, tablets, notebooks, and automobiles; adhesive materials used for semiconductor PKG packaging; and organic light-emitting diodes for displays. INNOX Advanced Materials Co.,Ltd was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Asan-si, South Korea.
